# Control: ID and title

- Owner/operator/reviewer:
- Status: PLANNED
- Risk/requirements:
- Systems/data/tenants in scope:

## Objective and threat

State the outcome and failure/abuse it prevents or detects.

## Implementation

Preventive/detective/corrective components, policy, frequency, segregation, dependencies and fail behavior.

## Verification and evidence

Automated/manual test, evidence artifact/location/retention, review frequency, alert and runbook.

## Exceptions and residual risk

Owner, rationale, compensating control, approval, expiry and closure criteria.

## Framework mappings

Exact versioned identifiers with interpretation; mapping does not itself prove compliance.
